partners.mechanism_chain: GFER (HGNC:4149) —DISRUPTS→ Mitochondrial protein folding and quality control (GO:0005759); Mitochondrial protein folding and quality control (GO:0005759) —LEADS_TO→ Disease A Phenotype (HP:0000001); ATP5F1B (HGNC:7327) —DISRUPTS→ ATP Synthesis by Oxidative Phosphorylation (REACT:R-HSA-177678); ATP Synthesis by Oxidative Phosphorylation (REACT:R-HSA-177678) —DECREASES→ ATP (CHEBI:15422); ATP (CHEBI:15422) —LEADS_TO→ Hypermetabolism (HP:0004356). Loss-of-function mutations in GFER (Disease A) impair mitochondrial protein folding and quality control, indirectly affecting overall mitochondrial function. Loss-of-function mutations in ATP5F1B (Disease B) directly disrupt the ATP synthase complex, reducing ATP production and leading to hypermetabolism.
